name: Minimalist Shadow
description: Minimalist photography with artistic shadow play
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only add artistic shadow patterns on a clean white background. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only add shadow patterns and modify the environment around the unchanged product.

objects.description: The exact product from the input image, preserved as-is, with artistic shadow patterns
objects.relationship: Primary subject with artistic shadow as secondary design element
objects.relative_size: medium to large within frame with negative space

objects.texture: Clean, refined surface with soft shadow interplay
